repomix.user_provided_header: Phases 3 and 4: Inventory & Immutable Ledger, Transfers, Stocktakes, Pricing Engine & Customer Groups. Includes implementation, database schema and hardening migrations, validation, API resources/routes, permissions, numbering, supporting models/configuration, regression tests, and related frontend files (some frontend files are scaffolds). The application uses PostgreSQL. Paths are relative to the repository root. Review hardening: stale stocktakes require recount; branch-scoped staff operations; PostgreSQL sequence-based movement numbering (rollback gaps are expected); damaged stock restoration/write-off; bounded CSV import and streamed formula-safe export; real multi-process concurrency tests.
